text.en:
Section nine hundred and sixty-eight of Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and eleven,
known as the Administrative Code, is hereby amended to read as follows :
"Section 968. Except as provided in the foregoing section, a vacancy in any grade in the commissioned
service shall be filled by promotion from the grade next below that of the position in question. All promotions
to such vacancies shall be made fifty per cent by seniority and fifty per cent by selection."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 27, 1925.
